name: China
description: Rapidly modernizing aerospace power with mass serial production of 5th-generation J-20 stealth fighters, electromagnetic catapult carrier aircraft (J-15T, J-35), and advanced long-range PL-15/PL-17 BVRAAM missile technology.

militaryBranches.name: People's Liberation Army Air Force
militaryBranches.description: Heavy 5th-gen stealth fighters (J-20A/S), strike fighters (J-16), strategic standoff bombers (H-6N), and KJ-500 GaN AESA radar platforms.

militaryBranches.name: PLA Naval Air Force
militaryBranches.description: Carrier strike groups operating from Liaoning, Shandong, and Fujian supercarriers (J-15T, J-35, KJ-600 AEW&C).

militaryBranches.name: PLA Ground Force Aviation
militaryBranches.description: Battlefield attack helicopters (Z-10ME, Z-19) and medium utility transport helicopters (Z-20).
